Pree, the store is Pine Crossing. I replied in a thread under your message in #central-team.

Where that comes from: on 9 June you posted in #central-team that Pine Crossing's morning receiver saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver had shown up at 7:10, and they wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis said he would check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem using the store login.

"Pine Crossing" is the only site name I could find. The shared files have no Marrow Agrisupply account folder, so I can't give you a fuller site name or an address.
